source.title: 08-08 Meeting: Myriad Fun Ride — Landing Page, Registration, Kit Claim, Stress Test
speaker: Speaker 1
Speaker 2
Speaker 3
Speaker 4
Speaker 5

summary: In-person walkthrough of the Fun Ride registration site (under Myriad Events) between ADVO (Speaker 1 demos, addressed as Prince) and the organizer side (Speaker 2 leads; Alden, Justin and David are mentioned). Speaker 1 demos the mobile-first landing page, the 5/10/21K distance picker, a 20% senior discount that validates a government ID by camera (rejecting screen photos and non-seniors), GCash test payment, ticket download, Apple Wallet, volunteer accounts limited to check-in and kit-claim, offline scanning, and manual lookup by name, ID or ticket code. The organizer asks to drop the route map for now and show only DOT as sponsor, to require a hard-copy parent authorization at kit claim for minors, and settles on a single QR for both kit claim and check-in. PayMongo verification has been pending about 8 days, so only QR Ph is available; credit cards are not. They agree to run a live stress test on Saturday morning with the price set to one peso, non-refundable, targeting 50 to 100 simultaneous registrants, and to have initial early-bird registration up by the 12th with early bird running to September 10. Late tangents cover a proposed follow-on mobile app (App Store P5,000 yearly), invoice copies, BDO payment coordination, and family banter.

fact.claim: The Fun Ride landing page is built mobile-first and currently lists two events.
fact.quote: So, ito po yung, Yung landing page Ng fun ride page mismo. Ito lang mo, magiging mobile lang talaga. ... So, sa events, Dalawa pa lang ngayon.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The organizer asked not to show the route map yet and to keep only the 5, 10 and 21 km distances on the page.
fact.quote: Wag marami natin lagay yung route map. Inclusion lang. Basta ang ano lang natin, 5, 10, and 21.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: For the initial launch, DOT is the only sponsor to be shown on the site.
fact.quote: Pero for now, for the initial, out ang sponsor. Ang sasailanganin ko lang ay DOT.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: PayMongo verification had been pending for 8 days at the time of the meeting.
fact.quote: 8 days pa lang. Kaya nang pag Monday natin, matatagalan tayo maghihintay.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The stress test will use QR Ph as the payment method first, with other payment methods to follow once PayMongo approves them.
fact.quote: We can try, ano, QRPH mo muna para makuha Muna natin yung data na Ma-stress test muna natin yung system. Pero yung ibang payment Method, ka-follow na lang.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The concurrency target discussed for the stress test is 100 simultaneous logins, and the concern is that Vercel should not break under it.
fact.quote: Kahit 1 million? Kahit 100 sabay-sabay? ... O, 100 lang. ... Kasi, may make sure lang na hindi sasabog si Versailles.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: A separate waiver will exist for minors below 18.
fact.quote: Magkakaroon siguro ng separate for minors. So kung below 18, may under waiver.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: The site offers a 20% senior discount that is applied by pointing the camera at an ID.
fact.quote: Kung mangyari may senior citizen, I-pin mo lang yung get senior discount. 20% off. Tapos, itatapat mo lang yung ID.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The ID scan shows 'Discount not applied' when the scanned person is not a senior and can detect whether the ID is a physical card or an edited photo.
fact.quote: Discount not applied. Sabi daw, 19 years old ako. Makita yung name mo, yung birthday. ... Tsaka, madedetect niya kung... ID hawak mo or... Kung kunyari ganun, hindi siya gagana. Ma-detect niya.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: A company ID that carries only a QR and no printed birthday cannot be used for the senior discount; a government ID is needed.
fact.quote: Ay, company ID lang. Hindi, basta may basic. Basta may birthday siya. ... Ah, hindi nakalagay yung birthday? Oo. ... Pang-government ID tayo.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The risk of a faked senior ID is accepted as a rare edge case worth roughly P150 per fraudulent discount.
fact.quote: So parang hindi, medyo rare yung edge case na gano'n. Parang the pros outweigh the cons. Mga 150 lang masasayang mo doon.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The ID scanner rejects photos of a screen but accepts the eGov app ID.
fact.quote: This is a photo of a screen. Photograph the actual card. Or kapag EGOV pitch up, pwede siya. ... Kasi mga senior citizen, nasa app yung EGOV yung ID na rin.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: GCash payment was demoed in test mode only.
fact.quote: Pag-Gcash payment. ... Pero naka-test pa lang ngayon. Ayan. So, kunyari, authorized.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: After registration, tickets for all participants can be downloaded and are also emailed, with an Apple Wallet option.
fact.quote: Tapos download lang sila ng ticket. ... Or, mag-e-mail din sa kanila. ... Kaya ba managin din sa Apple Wallet? Uy, Apple Wallet. O, pwede mong lo.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Check-in and kit claim work offline with a reference number when there is no signal.
fact.quote: Let's say down po yung signal, We'll have a reference number na lang yung sumabay. ... Compatible siya sa offline din. So, kahit walang signal yung, or yung nagsaskal, pwede siya.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Volunteers can be given accounts that only access check-in or kit-claim.
fact.quote: So, this one, pwede nga bigyan ng account yung mga volunteer. So, either check-in or kit-claim. Yan lang ang maa-access.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: It was settled that a single QR code will be used for both kit claim and check-in, replacing the two-QR behaviour seen in the demo.
fact.quote: Pero isang QR code lang siya. So, isa lang gagamitin mo for kit claim tsaka check-in. Oo, basta isa na yun.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The organizer wants a size chart picture for event shirts on the site.
fact.quote: May size chart ba? Ha? May size chart? Pwede tayo maglagay yung picture. ... Dapat may size chart ko. Meron, meron.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Kit fulfillment includes a delivery option, and if the QR fails the volunteer can type the name, ID or ticket code instead.
fact.quote: Either kit claim yan, kasi may option din na delivery ah. ... Tsaka kung hindi gumana yung QR, pwede mong itype yung name or yung ID nila. Or pwede rin yung ticket code.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The scanning app must work offline, and volunteers enter their name or station (e.g. Gate 1) so entries can be tracked per station.
fact.quote: So, basta, importante, kahit offline, gagana yan doon. ... Tapos dito, lalagay nyo lang Kung yung name nyo Or yung station. kunwari gate 1.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Children have distance limits by age, e.g. a 9-year-old may only join the 2, 3 or 5 km distances, for safety.
fact.quote: Kaya kunyari, 9 years old ka, 2, 3, 5 kilo. ... Para for safety.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: Minors will accept the waiver online but must present a hard-copy parent authorization when claiming the race kit.
fact.quote: We can make it so that Upon claiming their race kit nila, Kailangan nila i-present authorization ng. ... Hard copy. So, lagay na lang natin yun.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The organizer will supply a waiver template and an authorization template to be built into the system.
fact.quote: So sa end namin, waiver. Waiver. ... Authorization. ... Waiver and authorization template.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: A designated area for same-day kit claiming will collect minors' authorization documents on event day.
fact.quote: We'll just have a designated area na lang po For same day cleaning. Para doon din yung mga authorization na Doon na lang po natin ilalagyan.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The organizer wants initial early-bird registration live by the 12th, before the 13th, with early bird running until September 10 and regular registration after.
fact.quote: Ma-up natin ang initial registration by 12, para before the 13, kasi yun yung sinasabi nilang gross month, to September 10. Para initial, ang ano lang natin, early bird, tapos saka na natin, for the regular registration.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: ADVO can have the site changes up by next week; the only blocker is PayMongo, though the QR Ph page already works.
fact.quote: we can have the changes up by next week. Ang hinihintay lang po naman natin is pay mo. Yup, yup. Pero, yung QR page should be working na.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: Credit card payment is not currently available; only QR Ph is, and Apple Pay is weak.
fact.quote: Ang wala lang po talaga, currently yung credit cards. ... Medyo mahina pa nga po Apple Pay. Wala pa ibang mga credit cards.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The stress test is set for Saturday morning, lasting about 1 to 2 hours, with the timing depending on how many people register at the same time.
fact.quote: Mga ilang oras? Is 1 hour lang yan or 2 nasabay-sabay? ... Kasi nga nakadepende naman po yung timing dun sa amount ng tao na nag-register sa same time.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The stress test will run in live mode with the price set to one peso, non-refundable.
fact.quote: Pero change natin yung price. Piso lang. ... Piso lang muna. Piso na lang. Live na lang. Live na natin. Para piso-piso lang. ... Non-refundable.
fact.speaker: Speaker 3

fact.claim: Publishing a follow-on app costs about P5,000 yearly on the App Store, while the Play Store is a one-time payment.
fact.quote: Yung sa paglagay sa App Store. Tapos si Ryan. 5K yearly yun eh. Sa Play Store, 1 time payment naman.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: When a scanned participant is detected as a minor, a pop-up will show the waiver with signature and a confirm button.
fact.quote: Tapos kapag bata, Kapag na-scan, tapos na-detect na bata, may pop-up mo na, ha? Na, confirm, ah, see for, ano yun? Waiver with signature. Tapos may confirm button.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The stress test expects roughly 50 to 100 people registering.
fact.quote: Saturday will be the stress test in the morning. So we will just wait for your time. So most likely, 50 man pa. 100. 100? Maraming.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: 'Add another' registers additional participants under the same email, auto-copying contact details so only the name and birthday change, and the senior discount applies per name.
fact.quote: Ad another na. Tapos auto-copy na yung, Contact details. Okay, okay. So, name na lang po ang magpalitan. Tsaka yung birthday mo, birthday. ... So, kunwari yung senior discount, Maa-apply sa name niya.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: The registration flow is one page for all participant info and a second page for payment.
fact.quote: Isang page lang, nandoon na lahat. Opo. In just one. ... Yung second page's payment mismo.
fact.speaker: Speaker 2

fact.claim: The platform runs under Myriad Events and supports multiple organizers on one event.
fact.quote: Kasi under Myriad Events. Oo, under Myriad. ... Fun ride din. Oo. Pwede natin ni, Multiple organizers isang event.
fact.speaker: Speaker 1

fact.claim: BDO payment integration is a separate request handled by a separate agency, and the organizer plans to call the payment provider's owner to speed things up.
fact.quote: Oo. Kasi, separate pa yung BDO. Ang nirequest ko pala yung BDO. ... Separate agency.
fact.speaker: Speaker 4

fact.claim: The stress test is scheduled for 2026-08-08 (Saturday) in the morning.
fact.quote: Planong simulan ang stress test gamit ang QRPH/QR ngayong Sabado ng umaga (2026-08-08), 1–2 oras, maraming sabay-sabay na registrants

decision.text: Do not show the route map for now; show only the 5, 10 and 21 km distances and inclusions.
Only DOT is shown as sponsor for the initial launch.
Start the stress test with QR Ph as the only payment method; other methods follow after PayMongo approval.
Use one QR code for both kit claim and check-in, not two.
Minors accept the waiver online, but a hard-copy parent authorization is required at kit claim; a same-day claiming area will collect it on event day.
Run the stress test live (not test mode) at a one-peso, non-refundable price, on Saturday morning.
Registration is one page for participant info plus a second page for payment; 'Add another' handles multiple registrants under one email.

action.description: Supply the waiver and authorization templates for minors so ADVO can build them into the system.
Get the site changes up by next week ahead of the 12th early-bird launch.
Email PayMongo to follow up on the pending verification.
Set the registration price to one peso, live and non-refundable, and run the Saturday-morning stress test with 50 to 100 registrants.
Draft a proposal for the next project (mobile app) after this one.
Add a pop-up with waiver-with-signature and confirm button when a scanned participant is detected as a minor.
Create the 'window QR' so payments route to the organizer's account.
Add a size chart image for event shirts.
Link other organizer accounts (e.g. Fun Ride Manila) under the Myriad admin account.
Call the payment provider's owner and coordinate the separate BDO request.

openQuestion.text: When will PayMongo finish verification so card and other payment methods become available?
Is there a target date for system testing beyond the Saturday-morning stress test?
Which invoice copies (photo or PDF) are needed and what do the amounts 11, 11.7, 4.7 and 7.4 refer to?
Should the site require ID uploads for all participants or only for senior discount?

person.note: Organizer lead; decides on route map, sponsors, stress test terms, BDO coordination.

person.name: Alden
person.note: Organizer-side figure; owns a Colnago bike; asked to be part of the stress test (36:47, 54:21).

person.name: Ryan
person.note: Mentioned alongside the App Store fee (39:50).
